guardian_pair_ceiling.note: A single same-weights pair's squared score gap divided by the total across-model variance in that scenario. This is a HARD CEILING: any weights-only readout is mechanically blind to the wrapper, so it cannot explain more of the across-model variance than genuinely different weights leave unexplained once this much is already wrapper-only noise.
